untertitel: Basic settings, network, services, updates and maintenance of your FAH-NAS.
lade_fehl: The system data could not be loaded.
hostname_erklaerung: The NAS is reachable on the network under this name, e.g. “fahnas” → smb://fahnas.local. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
hostname_fehler: Hostname: 1–63 characters from a-z, 0-9 and -, must not start or end with -.
zeitzone_erklaerung: Determines timestamps in logs, snapshots and schedules.
sprache_erklaerung: Interface language for everyone who hasn't switched it themselves via “DE/EN” at the top right. Some system messages stay in German.
design_erklaerung: Light, dark or as set by the device.
netz_warnung: Caution: a wrong address cuts the connection to the interface. Then only the NAS console or SSH can help. When in doubt, keep DHCP and reserve the address in the router.
netz_schnittstelle_erklaerung: Name of the network adapter, e.g. “enp1s0” or “eth0” (at most 15 characters). Empty = the first wired adapter.
netz_schnittstelle_fehler: Interface name: 1–15 characters from letters, digits, dot, colon, - and _.
netz_modus_erklaerung: DHCP: the router assigns the address (recommended). Static: you enter address, gateway and DNS yourself.
netz_adresse_erklaerung: IPv4 with the netmask as prefix, e.g. 192.168.1.50/24.
netz_gateway_fehler: Please enter an IPv4 address such as 192.168.1.1.
netz_dns_erklaerung: One address per line, at most three. Empty = from the router.
netz_dns_zuviele: At most {max} DNS servers – please remove lines.
netz_vergleich_erklaerung: This is what the change looks like. If the new address is wrong, you won't be able to reach the interface afterwards.
netz_gespeichert: Network has been changed. If the address changed, open the interface at the new address.
standort_erklaerung: Basis for the world map on the dashboard: where the NAS is located, whether it records its connections and where location data comes from. Everything stays on the NAS – no IP address is sent to third-party services.
standort_breite_erklaerung: North–south position of the NAS in degrees, e.g. 48.6284 (−90 to 90, south negative, comma or dot). The arcs on the world map start here. Both fields empty = no location; the map then only shows dots.
standort_breite_fehler: Latitude: please enter a number from −90 to 90, e.g. 48.6284.
standort_laenge_erklaerung: East–west position in degrees, e.g. 11.7989 (−180 to 180, west negative). Tip: long-press the place in a map app and copy the two numbers.
standort_laenge_fehler: Longitude: please enter a number from −180 to 180, e.g. 11.7989.
standort_paar_fehler: Please enter both latitude and longitude – or leave both fields empty.
standort_name_erklaerung: Shown on the map at the location, e.g. “Sandelzhausen”. May stay empty, at most 64 characters.
standort_name_fehler: Place name: at most {max} characters, no control characters.
verbindungen_aufzeichnen_erklaerung: For one hour, the NAS keeps in memory which addresses it, its apps and VMs are connected to and who contacts it. None of this is written to disk or the log. Off = no recording, the world map stays empty. Takes effect immediately, no restart.
geo_stadt_laden: Load location data monthly (DB-IP City Lite, approx. 60 MB)
geo_stadt_laden_erklaerung: Downloads the free city database from DB-IP.com once a month so the map shows cities instead of just countries. Lookups happen on the NAS itself – no IP address leaves the device. Off = only the bundled country database (dot at the country center).
geo_stand_land: Current: countries only – the city database is not loaded yet.
proxys_erklaerung: One address or network per line, e.g. 192.168.1.23 or 192.168.48.0/20, at most {max}. Only requests from these addresses may pass on the visitor's real address (X-Forwarded-For). Needed when the interface runs behind a proxy such as Nginx Proxy Manager – otherwise the sign-in lockout counts all visitors as one. Empty = no proxy.
proxys_fehler: Trusted proxies: “{wert}” is neither an IP address nor a network (e.g. 192.168.1.23 or 192.168.1.0/24).
proxys_zuviele: At most {max} trusted proxies – please remove lines.
standort_gespeichert: Location and connections have been saved – the world map picks them up on its next refresh.
dienste_erklaerung: Status light: green running, gray off, red error. Changes take effect immediately.
dienst_samba_erklaerung: Provides the shares via SMB. Off = no network drives.
dienst_docker_erklaerung: Runtime for apps from the catalog (subproject 2).
dienst_avahi_erklaerung: Announces the NAS as “name.local” and advertises Time Machine to Macs.
dienst_ssh_erklaerung: Console access over the network. Keep SSH on – if the interface is ever unreachable, it is your way back in.
dienst_ssh_aus_frage: Really turn off SSH? If the interface is ever unreachable, only a screen and keyboard on the NAS will help.
ssh_port_erklaerung: Port for SSH and SFTP. 22 is Ubuntu's default. A custom port (1024–65535) keeps automated scans from the network away.
ssh_port_hinweis: What changes: terminal, SFTP apps, scp, the Multitool and your own scripts need the new port afterwards (e.g. ssh -p 2222). Open connections stay up. Switch router rules for SSH (firewall, IPS exceptions) to the new port. The web interface (8443) and the shares (SMB) are not affected.
ssh_port_fehler: 22 or a port from 1024 to 65535, not 5353 or 8443.
ssh_port_frage: Switch SSH to port {port}? New connections will then only work on this port.
updates_erklaerung: Security and system updates from the Ubuntu sources. Before and after installing, the NAS creates system snapshots – if something goes wrong, boot the old version from the boot menu.
updates_keine: Everything up to date – no updates available.
updates_gefunden: {anzahl} updates available, {sicherheit} of them security updates.
updates_einspielen_frage: Install {anzahl} updates? A system snapshot is created before and after. A restart may be needed afterwards.
updates_rueckfall_titel: If something stops working after an update: boot the old version
updates_rueckfall: 1. Restart the NAS. 2. In the boot menu, open “FAH-NAS Schnappschüsse” and choose the “vor Update” entry with the matching time. 3. If everything works, make the version permanent under “Snapshots” → System with “Use at next boot”. Your data in the shares stays unchanged in any case.
docker_freigabe_erklaerung: Shares the app folder (Compose file, .env and data per app) on the network – admins only, with full rights.
docker_freigabe_warnung: Changed Compose files and .env take effect after stopping and starting the app; for catalog apps, FAH-NAS rewrites both when you change the settings.
programm_erklaerung: Installs a new FAH-NAS release (fahnas_release.tar.gz). A snapshot is created first; if the new version doesn't start, the old one runs again automatically.
programm_datei_erklaerung: The fahnas_release.tar.gz file of a FAH-NAS release.
programm_keine_datei: Please choose the release archive first.
programm_gleich: Version {neu} is already running – you can reinstall it.
programm_aelter: Warning: {neu} is older than the running version {alt} – this is a downgrade.
programm_frage: Update FAH-NAS to {neu}? The services restart and the interface is unreachable for about a minute.
programm_laeuft: Updating FAH-NAS to {nach} … The interface will briefly go away and come back by itself.
programm_erfolg: FAH-NAS {nach} is running. Reloading the page …
programm_fehler: The update to {nach} failed – {von} keeps running.
programm_abgebrochen: The update to {nach} was interrupted. Please check which version is running and try again.
programm_zeitueberschreitung: No response from the NAS after 5 minutes. Please reload the page.
energie_platten_erklaerung: After this many minutes without access, the hard disks go to sleep. 0 = never, at most {max} minutes (5.5 hours – the disk controller supports no more). SSDs don't benefit; spinning disks save power and noise but take a few seconds to wake up.
energie_fehler: Please enter a whole number from 0 to {max} (5.5 hours is the maximum).
smart_erklaerung: Self-monitoring of the drives. “Warning” means: replace soon and check your backup; “no values” is normal for USB sticks.
smart_fehl: S.M.A.R.T. values could not be read.
protokoll_erklaerung: Every action of the control center with user, time and result. Passwords are redacted. Failed actions are red.
protokoll_aufklappen: Click to open – shows the latest actions with a filter.
protokoll_nutzer_erklaerung: Only entries of this user. Empty = all.
protokoll_aktion_erklaerung: Start of the action name, e.g. “freigaben” or “nutzer.passwort”.
protokoll_fehl: The log could not be loaded.
export_erklaerung: The export contains all settings (users, shares, schedules, system) as an archive. Use it to restore the NAS after a reinstall.
export_geheimnisse_erklaerung: Also include password hashes and 2FA secrets. The archive is then encrypted with the password below.
export_passwort_erklaerung: At least 8 characters. Without this password the archive can't be read anymore – keep it safe.
export_passwort_fehler: With secrets, the archive needs a password (at least 8 characters).
import_erklaerung: Choose an archive from an earlier export. Before applying, the NAS shows you what would change.
import_datei_erklaerung: A “fahnas-export-….tar” file from the export; with secrets it is called “….tar.fahnas” (encrypted, password below).
import_passwort_erklaerung: Only needed if the export was encrypted with secrets.
import_vergleich_erklaerung: This is what would change. Only after “Apply” is the configuration replaced and rendered into the system.
import_keine_unterschiede: The archive matches the current configuration – nothing to do.
import_fehl: The archive could not be uploaded.
strom_erklaerung: Open connections to shares are closed. Running tasks are cancelled.
neustart_frage: Restart the NAS now? The interface will be unreachable for about a minute.
neustart_gestartet: The NAS is restarting. This page reloads itself in a minute.
herunterfahren_frage: Shut down the NAS now? You will then have to turn it on again at the device.
ueber_projekt: FAH-NAS is a custom NAS operating system based on Ubuntu Server – designed and programmed by Fabian Hammer. For personal use, not a commercial product.
benachrichtigung_erklaerung: The NAS notifies you by email or push to your phone (ntfy) when something is wrong – e.g. disk full, mirror job failed, app crashed.
benachrichtigung_email_erklaerung: Via an email account (SMTP), e.g. Gmail with an app password or your own mailbox.
benachrichtigung_server_erklaerung: Outgoing mail server of your email provider.
benachrichtigung_benutzer_erklaerung: Usually the account's email address; leave empty if the server doesn't require sign-in.
benachrichtigung_passwort_erklaerung: For Gmail, an app password. It stays locked away on the NAS.
benachrichtigung_empfaenger_erklaerung: One or more addresses, separated by commas.
benachrichtigung_ntfy_erklaerung: Push message to your phone via the free ntfy app. Switch on, scan the QR code, done – nothing to type.
benachrichtigung_ntfy_server_erklaerung: https://ntfy.sh or the address of your own ntfy server.
benachrichtigung_thema_erklaerung: FAH-NAS created a hard-to-guess topic – only change it if you already have your own.
benachrichtigung_token_erklaerung: Only needed if your ntfy server requires sign-in (alternatively user and password).
benachrichtigung_ntfy_benutzer_erklaerun: Only for ntfy servers with sign-in, if no token is set.
benachrichtigung_ereignis_platte_erklaer: Data disk almost full or a disk reports S.M.A.R.T. problems.
benachrichtigung_ereignis_apps_erklaerun: An app with autostart has crashed, keeps restarting or is unhealthy – and when it is running again.
benachrichtigung_ereignis_updates_erklae: FAH-NAS has been updated or system updates need a restart.
benachrichtigung_ereignis_usv_erklaerung: Power outage, battery low, power restored.
benachrichtigung_ereignis_vpn_erklaerung: A device has connected via VPN.
benachrichtigung_ereignis_vms_erklaerung: A VM with autostart is unexpectedly off.
vpn_erklaerung: Your own VPN server on the NAS: phone and laptop connect securely to the NAS or home network while on the go.
vpn_server_erklaerung: Turns on WireGuard on the NAS. Missing packages are installed automatically.
vpn_adresse_erklaerung: Your devices find your home under this name or IP while on the go. A DynDNS name is best, since the IP can change.
vpn_port_erklaerung: Forward this UDP port to the NAS in your router. If a VPN already runs on the router, the NAS needs a different port.
vpn_netz_erklaerung: Address range for VPN devices only. Must not overlap with any other network; the suggestion almost always fits.
vpn_netz_gesperrt: Can only be changed while no devices have been added.
vpn_dns_erklaerung: Empty = automatic: the NAS itself if it runs a DNS (e.g. an ad blocker), otherwise the home network's DNS.
vpn_laeuft: VPN is running on UDP {port}; the NAS has the address {ip} in the VPN.
vpn_laeuft_nicht: VPN is turned on but not running – the self-test shows why.
vpn_pakete: Turning it on will still install these packages (internet required): {pakete}.
vpn_keine_geraete: No device yet. Add one below and scan the QR code with the WireGuard app.
vpn_zugriff_erklaerung: Where the device may go through the VPN. “Everything” also routes internet traffic through your home (e.g. on public Wi-Fi).
vpn_zugriff_geaendert: Access for “{name}” changed – please reload the configuration on the device (QR code).
vpn_loeschen_frage: Delete device “{name}”? It will no longer be able to connect.
vpn_neu_erklaerung: For recognition, e.g. “iPhone” or “Laptop”. Each device gets its own keys.
vpn_konfig_erklaerung: In the WireGuard app, choose “Add tunnel → Scan QR code”. On a computer, download the file and import it into WireGuard.
vpn_qr_fehlt: QR code not available (package qrencode missing) – please use the file.
vpn_selbsttest_erklaerung: Checks service, firewall, public address and the connection. Then check nodes on the internet (check-host.net) send test packets to the port – if nothing arrives, this shows exactly what to do in the router.
gpu_erklaerung: Graphics cards can accelerate apps (video conversion, AI). Assign: Apps → app → Edit → Graphics card.
gpu_nv_docker_ok: Docker can pass the card to apps
gpu_nv_docker_fehlt: Docker is not set up for NVIDIA yet
gpu_nv_einrichten_erklaerung: Installs the matching driver and NVIDIA's Container Toolkit (internet required, a few minutes). Docker restarts once in the process.
gpu_nv_einrichten_frage: Set up NVIDIA now? All apps will be briefly unavailable because Docker restarts. A NAS restart may be needed afterwards.
gpu_nv_neustart: Installed – please restart the NAS so the driver loads.
gpu_apps_keine: No app uses the graphics card yet.
benachrichtigung_ereignis_energie_erklae: The NAS shuts down on schedule or postpones it because of running tasks.
energie2_erklaerung: Turn the NAS off automatically at night and on again in the morning, wake it over the network and shut it down safely during a power outage.
zeitplan_an_erklaerung: Shuts down the NAS on the selected days at the given time. If tasks are still running (update, mirror job), it waits up to 2 hours.
zeitplan_wieder_an_erklaerung: Sets the mainboard's wake-up alarm before shutting down. Only works if the BIOS allows “Wake on RTC”.
wol_an: Allow waking the NAS over the network
wol_an_erklaerung: A powered-off NAS starts when a wake packet arrives at {mac} ({schnittstelle}) – e.g. from a phone app.
wol_geraete_erklaerung: Wake other devices on the home network from here (e.g. the PC for a backup).
wol_neu_fehler: Please enter a name and MAC address (e.g. 00:11:22:33:44:55).
usv_an_erklaerung: During a power outage, the NAS notifies you and shuts down cleanly in time. Missing packages are installed automatically.
usv_art_erklaerung: USB: the UPS is connected directly to the NAS. Network: another device (e.g. another NAS) shares its UPS via NUT.
usv_host_erklaerung: Address of the device the UPS is connected to.
usv_benutzer_erklaerung: NUT server account – on Synology and UGREEN usually “monuser”.
usv_akku_unter_erklaerung: When the charge on battery drops to this value, the NAS shuts down.
usv_minuten: Shut down after minutes on battery
usv_minuten_erklaerung: 0 = by battery level only. Otherwise the NAS shuts down after this many minutes of power outage.
proto_titel: Network protocols (SMB, SFTP, WebDAV, NFS, DLNA)
proto_erklaerung: This is how computers and devices reach the shares – everyone sees only those they have rights to. The web interface’s file view reads straight from the disk and needs none of them.
proto_sftp_erklaerung: Transfer files securely via SSH, e.g. with FileZilla or Cyberduck: {adresse}, sign in with your NAS account.
proto_sftp_ssh_aus: SFTP runs via the SSH service – it will be enabled as well when you turn this on.
proto_webdav_erklaerung: Shares as a network drive via HTTPS: {adresse} (Mac: Finder → Connect to Server). The NAS certificate must be accepted once.
proto_nfs_erklaerung: For Linux computers and media players (NFSv4). NFS has no sign-in – access only from the allowed network, with the rights of the selected user.
proto_nfs_netz_erklaerung: Only devices from this network may mount, e.g. 192.168.1.0/24.
proto_nfs_freigaben: Shares via NFS (external drives are not supported):
proto_dlna_erklaerung: TVs, receivers and game consoles find movies, music and pictures automatically – read-only.
proto_dlna_name_erklaerung: This is how the NAS appears on the TV.
proto_wer_sieht: Who sees which shares via SFTP/WebDAV?
proto_extern_hinweis: External drives only appear with write access – “read-only” cannot be enforced on exFAT/NTFS.
proto_dlna_ordner_erklaerung: Media folders – whole shares or single subfolders:
proto_dlna_unterordner_erklaerung: Pick a folder to go into it; “this folder” stays where you are.
updates_aus_listen: Based on the current package lists – “Check” fetches the latest.
pruefungen_erklaerung: Disks test themselves regularly, storage pools compare all data once a month. Errors appear under “Action needed” and as notifications.
pruefungen_aktiv_erklaerung: A short self-test of all disks every week (about 2 minutes).
pruefungen_tag_erklaerung: The checks run on this day.
pruefungen_zeit_erklaerung: Best at night – the disks are woken up for it.
pruefungen_lang_erklaerung: On the first check day of the month the test reads the whole disk – this takes hours for large disks.
pruefungen_raid: Check storage pools once a month
pruefungen_raid_erklaerung: Compares the data of all disks in a pool and finds silent errors.
auto_erklaerung: Ubuntu installs updates by itself so you do not have to remember. You still update FAH-NAS itself under “Update FAH-NAS”.
auto_aktiv_erklaerung: Recommended: security holes are closed as soon as fixes are available.
auto_neustart_erklaerung: Some updates (e.g. kernel) only take effect after a restart. Off: “Action needed” reminds you.
auto_neustart_zeit_erklaerung: Only if a restart is needed.
auto_neustart_noetig: A restart is needed after updates.
wartung_fehlt: The settings cannot be read right now – the control service may be restarting.
proto_smb_erklaerung: Windows, Mac and Linux computers connect to {adresse} – also for Time Machine.
proto_smb_aus_hinweis: Off: computers on the network can no longer reach the shares via SMB, Time Machine stops. The web interface still shows the files.
schutz_erklaerung: Applies only to sign-ins from outside your home network and VPN. At home and via VPN you sign in as usual – without a two-factor code.
schutz_punkt_sperre: Block: after 3 failed attempts 1 hour, then 24 hours – only for access from the internet.
schutz_punkt_aufgabe: Bot brake: before every sign-in the browser solves a small computing task (about 1 second) – mass guessing becomes expensive.
schutz_punkt_2fa: Two-factor code: only needed from outside (if set up under “My account”).
schutz_punkt_meldung: Notification via ntfy/e-mail: every sign-in from the internet right away; blocks right away, further ones in the same hour collected in one message.
schutz_laender_erklaerung: Signing in from the internet only works from these countries – codes like DE, AT, CH, separated by commas. Empty = all countries. Share links work worldwide.
schutz_laender_fehler: Please enter countries as two-letter codes, e.g. DE, AT, CH.
schutz_stand: Last 24 hours: {fehler} failed {fehler|attempt|attempts}, {land} rejected because of the country, {gesperrt} {gesperrt|address|addresses} currently blocked.
schutz_ohne_meldung: Notifications are off – set up ntfy or e-mail below under “Notifications”, otherwise you won't be told about sign-ins from the internet.
benachrichtigung_ereignis_anmeldung_erkl: Every successful sign-in from outside home network/VPN and every block after failed attempts.
benachrichtigung_ntfy_schritt1: Install the free “ntfy” app on your phone (App Store or Google Play).
benachrichtigung_ntfy_schritt2: Scan the QR code with your phone camera – or tap “+” in the ntfy app and enter this topic:
benachrichtigung_ntfy_schritt3: Click “Send test” below – the test message must arrive on your phone.
benachrichtigung_ntfy_kopieren_fehl: Copying wasn't possible – please copy it by hand.
benachrichtigung_ntfy_eigen: Own ntfy server or different topic
gehaeuse_erklaerung: On UGREEN enclosures FAH-NAS drives the indicator LEDs and the fan itself – just like UGOS did.
gehaeuse_keines: No supported enclosure detected – LEDs and fan are handled by the hardware itself.
gehaeuse_leds_an_erklaerung: Off = all indicators dark (e.g. at night in the living room).
gehaeuse_helligkeit_dunkel: {prozent} % – barely visible, no disturbance at night.
gehaeuse_aktivitaet_erklaerung: Disk LEDs blink on read/write, the network LED on traffic. Red always stays on when a RAID disk fails.
gehaeuse_modus_bios_erklaerung: FAH-NAS does not regulate; the fan runs at the fixed BIOS value. Show only, no control.
gehaeuse_modus_leise_erklaerung: As quiet as possible: speeds up only with warmer disks (from 40 °C) and a hot CPU.
gehaeuse_modus_normal_erklaerung: Balanced (default): disks stay below about 45 °C, quiet when idle.
gehaeuse_modus_leistung_erklaerung: Cools earlier and harder – for full enclosures or warm rooms, but louder.
gehaeuse_watchdog_treiber: Hardware watchdog of the enclosure: {zustand} ({sekunden} s). FAH-NAS keeps it alive – it does not reset the NAS.
gehaeuse_watchdog_ohne: The watchdog driver does not know the chip – FAH-NAS switched the watchdog off at start so it does not reset the NAS.
gehaeuse_watchdog_unit: The start step for the watchdog could not be enabled ({grund}).
gehaeuse_watchdog_schutz_erklaerung: If the whole system hangs for three minutes, the watchdog restarts the NAS – as under UGOS. Off: the watchdog is only kept alive and never fires.
fahgit_erklaerung: Optional – only needed if you run your own FAH-Git server. Set up once, works for all projects: FAH-NAS reads projects and branches from FAH-Git and builds them as Docker apps under Apps → “Build from FAH-Git”. The button and the dashboard tile only appear once a connection is set up.
fahgit_ungeprueft: Connection saved but not checked yet.
fahgit_adresse_erklaerung: As in the browser, e.g. http://nas.local:3300 or https://git.example.org. If FAH-Git runs on this NAS, the NAS address with port 3300 is enough.
fahgit_token_erklaerung: Create a “read only” key in FAH-Git under “My account” and paste it here – it works for all projects of that account. Leave empty to keep the current key.
fahgit_gespeichert: Connection to FAH-Git saved (signed in as {nutzer}).
fahgit_pruefen_ok: FAH-Git is reachable and accepts the key.
fahgit_pruefen_fehl: FAH-Git is not reachable right now or rejects the key.
fahgit_entfernt: Connection to FAH-Git removed – built apps keep running.
